The '''Karran mantis''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insect]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Karra]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Karran mantis had six [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. It used the four rear legs for movement, while the two forelegs had long, spear-like appendages that could be used for attack. The segmented body had a horizontal abdomen and upright head and thorax. The head of the mantis resembled a head of an [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]].<ref name="AJ1" />

==History==
The [[Karran]]s used the mantis as a beast of war. It was kept in a state of hibernation in a cave until roused by the Karran. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], there was only one left on the planet. The Karran used it to attack an Imperial base.<ref name="AJ1" />
